unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote: TEKSHIRILDI (skan 35-bet): Ex.4 12 ta bo'shliq va 12 ta so'z ro'yxati skan bilan bir xil. Soatlar: a=5:45 (uzun 9, qisqa 5-6 orasida), b=7:15, c=6:45 (kitob namunasi), d=1:30, e=9:00, f=4:30, g=2:50, h=10:15, i=9:20 - raqamli 4 tasi skanda aniq. ARRIVALS/DEPARTURES jadvallari (reys raqami, shahar, vaqt, status, gate) skan bilan to'liq mos. Telling the Time nazariy quti 6 ta soat - hammasi mos. Xato topilmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (12 ta):
  an early, gets, has, arrives, long, a night, free,
  goes to, goes, watches, catches, afraid of

Har biri FAQAT BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

IKKI GURUH:
  1) OT BIRIKMALARI (1, 2, 3, 11):
     long walks, an early bird, a night owl, free time
  2) FE'LLAR (4–10, 12):
     hammasi 3-shaxs birlik shaklida (He + fe'l+S)

DIQQAT — 'goes' va 'goes to' farqi:
  He GOES home.      ('to' YO'Q — 'home' oldida hech qachon 'to' bo'lmaydi)
  He GOES TO bed.    ('to' BOR)

items.whyUz: 'long walks' = uzoq sayrlar. Matnda: 'going for long walks'.
'an early bird' = erta turuvchi odam. Unit sarlavhasidan.
'have a shower' = dush qabul qilmoq. 3-shaxs → has.
'watch TV' = televizor ko'rmoq. -ch → watchES. Artikl YO'Q.
'go TO bed' = yotmoq. Bu yerda 'to' BOR, 'the' esa yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng shu so'zlar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir birikma bilan to'liq gap tuzing.
Bob haqida yoki o'zingiz haqingizda gapirsangiz bo'ladi.

modelSentences.sentence: Bob loves going for long walks in the countryside.
modelSentences.uz: Bob qishloqda uzoq sayr qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

modelSentences.sentence: Bob is an early bird because he gets up at five o'clock.
modelSentences.uz: Bob erta turuvchi odam, chunki soat beshda turadi.

modelSentences.sentence: My brother is a night owl. He goes to bed at two o'clock.
modelSentences.uz: Akam kech yotuvchi odam. U soat ikkida yotadi.

modelSentences.sentence: He has a shower every morning.
modelSentences.uz: U har ertalab dush qabul qiladi.

modelSentences.sentence: After his shower, he gets dressed.
He catches the bus to work at six o'clock.
modelSentences.uz: U soat oltida ishga avtobusga chiqadi.

modelSentences.sentence: He goes home at five o'clock in the afternoon.
modelSentences.uz: U kunduzi soat beshda uyga ketadi.

modelSentences.sentence: He arrives at the aquarium at half past six.
modelSentences.uz: U akvariumga olti yarimda yetib boradi.

modelSentences.sentence: In the evening, he watches TV.
He goes to bed early because he gets up early.
modelSentences.uz: U erta yotadi, chunki erta turadi.

modelSentences.sentence: In his free time, he goes swimming.
He is afraid of sharks, so he never swims in the sea.
modelSentences.uz: U akuladan qo'rqadi, shuning uchun dengizda hech qachon suzmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again and make notes under the following headings. Close your books, look at your notes and talk about Bob's daily routine and free-time activities. Start like this: Bob is a dolphin trainer. He gets up at five o'clock in the morning...
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni qayta o'qing va sarlavhalar bo'yicha qayd yozing. Kitobni yoping, qaydlarga qarab Bobning kundalik tartibi va bo'sh vaqti haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHALAR:
  Bob's job:      — Bobning kasbi
  What Bob does:  — Bob nima qiladi
    in the morning   — ertalab
    in the afternoon — kunduzi
    in the evening   — kechqurun
    in his free time — bo'sh vaqtida

KITOB BERGAN BOSHLANISH:
  'Bob is a dolphin trainer. He gets up at five o'clock
   in the morning...'

QAYD OLISH — matnni to'liq yodlamang, faqat KALIT so'zlarni yozing:
  morning: get up 5:00 → shower → dressed → breakfast →
           bus 6:00 → aquarium 6:30 → feed dolphins → practise

So'ng qaydlarga qarab O'Z SO'ZINGIZ bilan gapiring.

structure.modelEn: Bob is a dolphin trainer. He works at an aquarium.
structure.noteUz: Kitob shu gap bilan boshlashni taklif qiladi.

structure.modelEn: He gets up at five o'clock in the morning, has a shower and gets dressed.
After breakfast, at about six o'clock, he catches the bus to work.
He arrives at the aquarium at half past six and feeds the dolphins. Then they practise for the show until lunchtime.
He has a break for lunch from half past twelve till half past one, and then the show starts.
At five o'clock he feeds the dolphins again and then he goes home.
In the evening he usually watches TV. He doesn't go out very often because he goes to bed early.
In his free time he loves going for long walks in the countryside with his dog, Jack.
He also likes swimming at the pool, but he never swims in the sea because he is afraid of sharks.
Bob feels very satisfied with his life because he has got a great job and he enjoys his free time.

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida vaqtni IKKI XIL aytish mumkin:

  1) AN'ANAVIY usul — past / to / quarter / half bilan
  2) RAQAMLI usul — shunchaki raqamlarni o'qish

MISOL: 6:45
  an'anaviy: (a) quarter to seven
  raqamli:   six forty-five

AN'ANAVIY USUL QOIDASI:

  DAQIQA 1–30 bo'lsa → PAST (o'tdi)
    6:15 → (a) quarter PAST six   (oltidan chorak o'tdi)
    6:20 → twenty PAST six
    6:30 → half PAST six

  DAQIQA 31–59 bo'lsa → TO (qoldi) va SOAT KEYINGISI
    6:45 → (a) quarter TO seven   (yettiga chorak qoldi)
    6:40 → twenty TO seven
    6:50 → ten TO seven

ESLAB QOLING:
  PAST — soat o'tgan qismi, SHU soat aytiladi
  TO   — soatgacha qolgan qism, KEYINGI soat aytiladi
rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — 'to' bilan soatni noto'g'ri aytish:

  5:40 → twenty TO SIX     ✅ (oltiga yigirma qoldi)
         twenty to five    ❌

  6:45 → quarter TO SEVEN  ✅ (yettiga chorak qoldi)
         quarter to six    ❌

'to' ishlatilganda soat BITTAGA OSHADI!

Va 'o'clock' FAQAT to'liq soatda:
  ✅ six o'clock       (6:00)
  ❌ six fifteen o'clock
rule.noteUz:
'quarter' va 'half' oldidagi artikl:
  a quarter past six / quarter past six — IKKALASI ham to'g'ri
  half past six — 'a' QO'YILMAYDI ('a half past six' XATO)

RAQAMLI USUL — juda oson:
  6:45 → six forty-five
  9:20 → nine twenty
  10:15 → ten fifteen

Bu usul vokzal, aeroport va rasmiy joylarda ko'proq ishlatiladi.
An'anaviy usul esa kundalik suhbatda.
rule.extraUz:
VAQT SO'RASH — ikki xil savol:
  What time is it?
  What's the time?
Ikkalasi bir xil. Javob: 'It's ...'

SOAT BILAN PREDLOG — AT:
  at six o'clock, at half past six, at 6:45
  ('in six o'clock' yoki 'on six o'clock' XATO)

KUN QISMI:
  6:00 ertalab  → six o'clock in the morning
  6:00 kechqurun → six o'clock in the evening
  Rasmiy: 6 am / 6 pm

exercises.instructionEn: We tell the time in two different ways.
exercises.instructionUz: Vaqtni ikki xil aytishni mashq qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: Kitobdagi jadvalni to'ldirib chiqing — har bir vaqt ikki xil.

items.whyUz: 60 − 40 = 20 qoldi → twenty TO. Soat 6 dan 7 ga oshadi!

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the clock faces, then, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example. Tell the time in both ways, as explained in the theory box.
exercises.instructionUz: Soat ko'rsatkichlariga qarang, so'ng juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling. Vaqtni IKKI XIL ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
SOATNI O'QISH:
  UZUN strelka — DAQIQA
  QISQA strelka — SOAT

Kitobdagi namuna:
  SA: What time is it?   SB: It's (a) quarter to seven.
  SA: What's the time?   SB: It's six forty-five.

SOATLAR:
  a — uzun strelka 9 da, qisqa 5 va 6 orasida → 5:45
  b — uzun strelka 3 da, qisqa 7 da           → 7:15
  c — uzun strelka 9 da, qisqa 6 da           → 6:45 (namuna)
  d — uzun strelka 6 da, qisqa 1 va 2 orasida → 1:30
  e — uzun strelka 12 da, qisqa 9 da          → 9:00
  f — raqamli: 4:30
  g — raqamli: 2:50
  h — raqamli: 10:15
  i — raqamli: 9:20

items.question: What time is it?
items.answer: It's (a) quarter to seven. / It's six forty-five.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. 60−45=15 qoldi → quarter TO SEVEN.

items.question: What time is it?
items.answer: It's (a) quarter to six. / It's five forty-five.
items.whyUz: Daqiqa 45 → 'to' va soat 5 dan 6 ga oshadi.

items.question: What time is it?
items.answer: It's (a) quarter past seven. / It's seven fifteen.
items.whyUz: Daqiqa 15 (30 dan kam) → PAST, soat o'zgarmaydi.

items.question: What time is it?
items.answer: It's half past one. / It's one thirty.

items.question: What's the time?
items.answer: It's half past four. / It's four thirty.

items.question: What's the time?
items.answer: It's ten to three. / It's two fifty.
items.whyUz: 60−50=10 qoldi → ten TO THREE. Soat 2 dan 3 ga oshadi.

items.question: What's the time?
items.answer: It's (a) quarter past ten. / It's ten fifteen.

items.question: What's the time?
items.answer: It's twenty past nine. / It's nine twenty.

exercises.instructionEn: Ask and answer questions, as in the examples.
exercises.explanationUz:
AEROPORT JADVALLARI.

ARRIVALS (kelish):
  UN 908 | Tokyo    | 5:15 | on time | A4
  SW 575 | Brussels | 5:30 | on time | A1
  NW 202 | Montreal | 6:45 | on time | B6
  SA 117 | Cairo    | 7:00 | on time | B3

DEPARTURES (jo'nash):
  TWA 806 | New York  | 7:20 | now boarding | B6
  KLM 772 | Amsterdam | 8:10 | now boarding | C5
  EA 201  | Tel Aviv  | 8:15 | now boarding | C1
  AF 550  | Paris     | 8:45 | now boarding | B4

IKKI XIL PREDLOG — JUDA MUHIM:
  the plane FROM Tokyo   — Tokiodan KELADIGAN samolyot (arrivals)
  the plane FOR New York — Nyu-Yorkka KETADIGAN samolyot (departures)

IKKI XIL FE'L:
  arrive — kelmoq (arrivals)
  leave  — jo'namoq (departures)

Jadval so'zlari:
  on time      — vaqtida
  now boarding — hozir chiqish (samolyotga o'tirish) boshlandi
  gate         — chiqish eshigi
  origin       — qayerdan
  destination  — qayerga

items.question: What time does the plane from Tokyo arrive?
items.answer: It arrives at (a) quarter past five.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. 15 daqiqa → quarter past. Soat bilan AT.

items.question: What time does the plane from Brussels arrive?
items.answer: It arrives at half past five.
items.whyUz: 30 daqiqa → half past. Bryussel — Belgiya poytaxti.

items.question: What time does the plane from Montreal arrive?
items.answer: It arrives at (a) quarter to seven.

items.question: What time does the plane from Cairo arrive?
items.whyUz: To'liq soat → o'clock. Qohira — Misr poytaxti.

items.question: What time does the plane for New York leave?
items.answer: It leaves at twenty past seven.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. 'FOR New York' — ketadigan. 20 daqiqa → past.

items.question: What time does the plane for Amsterdam leave?
items.answer: It leaves at ten past eight.
items.whyUz: 10 daqiqa → ten past. Amsterdam — Gollandiya poytaxti.

items.question: What time does the plane for Tel Aviv leave?
items.answer: It leaves at (a) quarter past eight.

items.question: What time does the plane for Paris leave?
items.answer: It leaves at (a) quarter to nine.
items.whyUz: 45 daqiqa → quarter TO NINE. Parij — Fransiya poytaxti.

groups.explanationUz: To'rtta so'z bilan istalgan vaqtni aytish mumkin.
Chet elga chiqqanda darhol kerak bo'ladigan so'zlar.
Bitta harf farqi ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi.
Eng ko'p xato shu yerda. Uch guruhni farqlang.

patterns.formula: What time is it? / What's the time? — It's + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: What time is it? — It's (a) quarter to seven.
patterns.explanationUz: Ikkala savol ham bir xil. Javob doim 'It's' bilan.

patterns.exampleEn: It's twenty past nine. It's half past four.
patterns.explanationUz: 30 dan kam daqiqada PAST va SHU soat aytiladi.

patterns.formula: It's + daqiqa + TO + KEYINGI soat. (31–59 daqiqa)
patterns.exampleEn: It's ten to three. It's (a) quarter to nine.
patterns.exampleUz: Uchga o'n qoldi. To'qqizga chorak qoldi.
patterns.explanationUz:
60 dan daqiqani ayirasiz va soatni BITTAGA OSHIRASIZ.
2:50 → 60−50=10 → ten to THREE (ikki emas, uch!)

patterns.formula: What time does the plane FROM + shahar + arrive? — It arrives AT + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: What time does the plane from Tokyo arrive? — It arrives at (a) quarter past five.
patterns.exampleUz: Tokiodan keladigan samolyot qachon keladi? — U beshdan chorak o'tganda keladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
KELISH uchun: FROM + shahar, ARRIVE fe'li.
Soat bilan AT predlogi.

patterns.formula: What time does the plane FOR + shahar + leave? — It leaves AT + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: What time does the plane for New York leave? — It leaves at twenty past seven.
patterns.exampleUz: Nyu-Yorkka ketadigan samolyot qachon jo'naydi? — U yettidan yigirma o'tganda jo'naydi.
patterns.explanationUz: JO'NASH uchun: FOR + shahar, LEAVE fe'li.

patterns.exampleEn: He gets up at five o'clock. He arrives at the aquarium at half past six.
patterns.exampleUz: U soat beshda turadi. U akvariumga olti yarimda yetib boradi.
patterns.explanationUz: Soat bilan doim AT. Fe'l 3-shaxs birlikda -s oladi.
